title: trashlab overview
description: Everything trashlab on one page. Generated from knowhere trashlab/scripts/overview_dashboard.py; edits made in the UI are lost.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing in Prometheus, without Watchdog and info alerts. The table below lists them.

panels.title: Pods not ready
panels.description: Pods that are pending, failed or unknown, plus running pods that aren't ready. Finished job pods don't count.

targets.expr: (sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase=~"Pending|Unknown|Failed"}) or vector(0)) + (sum(kube_pod_status_ready{condition="false"} * on(namespace, pod) group_left() (kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Running"} == 1)) or vector(0)) and on() count(kube_pod_status_phase) > 0

panels.title: Flux not ready
panels.description: Flux Kustomizations, HelmReleases and sources that aren't ready (from the Flux Operator). The GitOps table lists them.

panels.title: Secrets not synced
panels.description: ExternalSecrets that can't sync from Bitwarden SM. Workloads keep the last synced value.

panels.title: Cert expiry
panels.description: Time until the first cert-manager certificate expires. cert-manager renews 30 days before, so under 25 days means a renewal failed.

panels.title: ex44 disk free
panels.description: Free space on ex44's root filesystem (NVMe RAID), which also holds Longhorn's volumes.

panels.title: Offsite backup
panels.description: Age of the last successful k8up backup to B2, for the app whose backup is oldest. Red after 26 hours.

targets.expr: time() - min(max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_completion_time * on(namespace, job_name) group_left() kube_job_labels{label_k8up_io_type="backup"}) or on(namespace) max by (namespace) (label_replace(k8up_schedules_gauge, "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.+)")) * 0)

panels.title: Longhorn backup
panels.description: Age of the last Longhorn backup to the Storage Box, for the volume whose backup is oldest. Volumes excluded from backups don't count.

panels.title: Restic errors
panels.description: Files restic couldn't read in the last offsite backup, which k8up still reports as successful. Only the last volume per app is known, and the raw database volumes are skipped.

panels.title: Storage Box
panels.description: Used space of the fullest Hetzner Storage Box, snapshots included. The StorageBoxAlmostFull alert fires above 85%.

panels.title: Last location
panels.description: Time since the newest Dawarich location point. If it keeps growing, iPhone tracking has stopped. The DawarichNoNewPoints alert fires after 24 hours.

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Longhorn volumes that are degraded or faulted.

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts firing now, newest first. The same alerts go to Discord.

panels.title: Backups per app
panels.description: Age of the last backups per app: Longhorn (the volume whose backup is oldest) and offsite to B2 (k8up). Then restic errors of the last backed-up volume (raw database volumes skipped), the size of the app's restic repository in B2 with all versions and its growth in 24 hours. Forgejo has no offsite backup yet.

targets.expr: time() - max by (app) (label_replace((max by (namespace) (kube_job_status_completion_time * on(namespace, job_name) group_left() kube_job_labels{label_k8up_io_type="backup"}) or on(namespace) max by (namespace) (label_replace(k8up_schedules_gauge, "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.+)")) * 0), "app", "$1", "namespace", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Backblaze B2
panels.description: All restic repositories in the bucket, hidden versions included (kept 30 days), which is what Backblaze bills. Measured hourly by the b2-usage job. Cost at $6.95 per TB and month; egress is free up to three times the stored amount.

panels.title: ex44 disk used
panels.description: Used share of ex44's root filesystem over time.

panels.title: Largest Longhorn volumes
panels.description: Space each volume takes on ex44's disk, including snapshots and blocks Longhorn hasn't trimmed yet.

panels.title: B2 usage
panels.description: Size of each restic repository in B2 over time, hidden versions included.

panels.title: Storage Boxes
panels.description: Hetzner Storage Boxes: used space against the quota, split into data and snapshots, and which access is on. Reachable externally should be off (open hardening item).

panels.title: Apps
panels.description: Per app: ready pods, running pods that aren't ready, container restarts in 24 hours, requests through Traefik in the last hour (count, share of 5xx answers and 95th percentile latency) and database size. Traefik only sees external requests. Its largest latency bucket is 5 s, and long-lived connections such as Immich's websocket land there.

targets.expr: (sum by (app) (label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"(authentik|dawarich|immich|nextcloud|forgejo)-.*", code=~"5.."}[1h]), "app", "$1", "service", "([a-z]+)-.*")) or sum by (app) (label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"(authentik|dawarich|immich|nextcloud|forgejo)-.*"}[1h]), "app", "$1", "service", "([a-z]+)-.*")) * 0) / sum by (app) (label_replace(rate(traefik_service_requests_total{service=~"(authentik|dawarich|immich|nextcloud|forgejo)-.*"}[1h]), "app", "$1", "service", "([a-z]+)-.*"))

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests per second through Traefik, per app.

panels.title: 5xx answers
panels.description: Server errors per minute through Traefik, per app.

panels.title: Immich
panels.description: Photos and videos (archived and locked ones included, the bin and the video parts of Live Photos not), size of all originals from EXIF, items in the bin and jobs running now over all queues. Immich creates its job metrics on the first job after a restart, so 0 jobs can also mean none ran since then.

panels.title: Authentik
panels.description: Authentication flows planned in 24 hours (a stand-in for logins), outposts with at least one connection (the embedded one runs the forward auth for the Flux, Longhorn and Traefik UIs) and failed background tasks in 24 hours.

panels.title: Nextcloud
panels.description: Accounts, accounts active in the last 24 hours, files Nextcloud knows about (versions and previews included) and free space on its data volume, from the serverinfo API.

panels.title: Dawarich
panels.description: Location points stored (from the table stats), time since the newest point and points recorded in the last 24 hours.

panels.title: Flux resources not ready
panels.description: Flux objects that aren't ready, suspended ones included. Flux failures also reach Discord through the notification-controller.

panels.title: Most restarts in 7 days
panels.description: Pods with the most container restarts in the last 7 days.

panels.title: CPU and memory
panels.description: Used share of ex44's CPU and memory.

panels.title: Load
panels.description: System load against the number of CPU threads.

panels.title: Temperatures
panels.description: CPU package and NVMe temperatures.

panels.title: Network
panels.description: Throughput of ex44's uplink (enp5s0). Offsite backups show as outgoing traffic.

panels.title: Error lines
panels.description: Pod log lines with the word error or an error or fatal level, over time (VictoriaLogs).

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:* (i(error) or log.level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$" or level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$") | stats count() as lines

panels.title: Error lines per namespace
panels.description: Error lines per namespace in the selected time range, the 7 noisiest.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:* (i(error) or log.level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$" or level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$") | stats by (kubernetes.pod_namespace) count() as lines | sort by (lines desc) | limit 7

panels.title: Latest error lines
panels.description: The newest pod log lines with the word error or an error or fatal level. Open a line for its fields.

targets.expr: kubernetes.pod_namespace:* (i(error) or log.level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$" or level:~"(?i)^(error|err|fatal|critical|panic)$") | format if (_msg:"missing _msg field; see https://docs.victoriametrics.com/victorialogs/keyconcepts/#message-field") "<log.error>" as _msg
